# MetricOra

> Carbon evidence and reporting software for UK contractors: guided PPN 006 Carbon Reduction Plans, SECR and GHG Protocol reports built from reviewed records, with a field app for site teams.

## Product
- [Product](https://www.metricora.co.uk/product): how records, calculations, review and reports fit together
- [Field app](https://www.metricora.co.uk/field-app): photograph waste tickets, delivery notes and fuel receipts, offline
- [Methodology](https://www.metricora.co.uk/methodology): how emissions are calculated and which factor libraries are used
- [Pricing](https://www.metricora.co.uk/pricing): plans priced per organisation

## Solutions
- [Construction](https://www.metricora.co.uk/solutions/construction)
- [Waste and haulage](https://www.metricora.co.uk/solutions/waste-haulage)
- [Public sector](https://www.metricora.co.uk/solutions/public-sector)

## Guides
- [Blog](https://www.metricora.co.uk/blog): guides to PPN 006, SECR and Scope 3
- [Resources](https://www.metricora.co.uk/resources)
